title: Monorepo + pnpm + TS/ESM + CI (build/test/lint) skeleton
context: Open-Spending-Explainers follows Hee-Lee Oss engineering conventions: TypeScript, ESM, pnpm workspaces. All subsequent pipeline, gate, and content tasks depend on a working monorepo skeleton with a green CI baseline. This cold-start task sets up the project structure so that neutrality-003 (lint), license-004 (provenance gate), and all later pipeline packages have a home and a CI harness to run in.
objective: Bootstrap the project monorepo with pnpm workspaces, TypeScript ESM configuration, an initial CI pipeline (build, test, lint), and the package structure that downstream pipeline and gate tasks will populate.
acceptanceCriteria: pnpm workspace with TypeScript ESM configuration compiles cleanly from a fresh checkout
CI pipeline (build/test/lint) runs and passes on the skeleton; subsequent package additions do not require CI re-architecture
Package layout provides homes for lib/editorial, lib/provenance, lib/ingest, lib/reconcile, lib/context, lib/pii, lib/explainer, site/, and scripts/ as described in PLAN.md
Dependency and secret scanning are wired into CI
README notes the project description, license (MIT for code; CC-BY-4.0 for content/datasets), and contribution flow
PR merged with green CI; maintainer review passed
output: A merged PR containing the monorepo skeleton: pnpm workspace, TypeScript ESM config, CI pipeline (build/test/lint), package structure matching the PLAN.md architecture, and dependency/secret scanning — the foundation all subsequent tasks build on.
